_what: The duplicated-source ratchet. `cloneCeiling` is the number of clone PAIRS jscpd finds in src/ with the flags fixed in scripts/check-source-duplication.mjs; it may only fall, and a fall must be pinned here so it cannot grow back. `filePairs` is diagnostic -- it is what lets a failure name which duplication is new instead of printing a number.
_why_not_zero: Zero is deliberately not the target. The remainder is adjudicated variants and two-instance pairs below the Rule of Three, and forcing those into one shape welds together things that change independently. The rule this serves is that duplication may not GROW unnoticed.
_json_ignored: Registry and schema files duplicate their own structure -- 7 such pairs on 2026-09-11 -- an inert floor that moves when config is edited and says nothing about copy-paste in code.
